# Disc Image Studio

An open-source C# application that encodes visual images into optical disc data tracks for burning graphic patterns onto media.

**Link:** https://github.com/JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio

## What creators claimed

- Demoed as a tool to burn visible pictures directly onto CDs, DVDs, and Blu-rays using standard burners. ([DfcTA74D4Bs](../reels/DfcTA74D4Bs.md))
